description: LIHCEL crystallizes in the trigonal crystal system with space group R -3. Reported CIF formula moiety: C132 H204 La20 N36 Ni30 O216, 72 H2 O. From the CIF bond table, La1 (La) has 9 O neighbors; La2 (La) has 15 O neighbors; La3 (La) has 11 O neighbors; La4 (La) has 11 O neighbors; Ni1 (Ni) has 7 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3 (Ni) has 7 O neighbors; Ni4 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni10 (Ni) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal connectivity is not established from the available bond table. Article card reports molecular formula [La20Ni30(IDA)30(CO3)6(NO3)6(OH)30(H2O)12](CO3)6·72H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 6 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 30 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
